summary: Completed comprehensive testing of passport OCR feature (Pasaport Tek Adım). All critical features working correctly: OCR reads passport data and auto-fills 6 fields, summary card displays correctly, edit functionality works, end-to-end application flow completes successfully, multiple travelers supported, OCR failure handled gracefully, and key pages load without errors.
passed_tests: Backend API: Passport upload (/api/uploads) working correctly
Backend API: Passport OCR (/api/passport/read) working - all 7 fields extracted correctly (AHMET, YILMAZ, U12345678, 1990-08-15, 2032-01-20, male, 12345678901)

CRITICAL: Passport OCR → Summary Card - OCR completes in ~10-30s, success message appears, summary card displays with all expected values (Ad Soyad, Doğum tarihi, Cinsiyet, Pasaport no, Geçerlilik, T.C. kimlik no), 6 form fields removed from DOM
Edit Button - Clicking 'Düzenle' button closes summary card, reopens 6 form fields with OCR values pre-filled, field modification works
CRITICAL: End-to-End Flow - Application completed successfully from step 1 to step 4 (payment) with only contact info, visa type, dates, and photo filled manually; traveler info auto-filled from OCR
Passport Single Upload - Passport uploaded in step 1 shows as 'Yüklendi' in step 3, no duplicate upload required
Multiple Travelers - Added 2nd traveler, both passports uploaded and OCR completed independently, both summary cards visible, total price calculated correctly (10.840 ₺ for 2 travelers)

OCR Failure Handling - Invalid image triggers user-friendly error message 'Pasaport otomatik okunamadı; bilgileri elle girebilirsiniz', summary card does not appear, 6 fields remain visible and editable
Regression: Homepage, /vize-tipleri, /takip, /esim, /seyahat-sigortasi all load without console errors
